request.text: Resume tomorrow's old-town walking plan. Check the weather first, and only adjust the retained route if rain makes the riverside section a bad idea.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up tomorrow's weather for the retained old-town walking itinerary before deciding whether a route change is warranted.
Continue the retained walking plan unchanged unless forecast rain warrants replacing its riverside section with the retained covered alternative.

active_goal_snapshots.description: Prepare a walk through Prague Old Town for tomorrow.
constraints: Change the route only when relevant conditions justify it.
success_criteria: The user receives a weather-appropriate walking itinerary without losing compatible retained stops.

activities.description: Draft the old-town walk with a riverside section and a covered fallback.
Obtain the relevant forecast before selecting between retained segments.

current_work.summary: Primary route includes Old Town Square, the riverside path, and Charles Bridge. Covered fallback preserves the square and bridge while replacing the riverside path with an arcade route.

semantic_facts: Weather lookup should precede any conditional modification of the retained walking route.
The retained primary route should remain intact if the forecast does not justify the rain fallback; otherwise only the riverside segment should be replaced by the covered alternative.
forbidden_claims: The assistant invents a forecast or treats unobserved rain as established fact.
The assistant discards the whole retained itinerary, starts physical walking, or creates a new walking Goal.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A conditional continuation mutates retained work before obtaining its required external evidence.
A capability-backed update expands into wholesale replanning or fabricated environmental facts.
